subject: Commit invoice allocation & revenue recognition clarifications for BrightApps multi-year prepay
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy@brightapps.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Commit invoice allocation & revenue recognition clarifications for BrightApps multi-year prepay

Hi Amy — great to have BrightApps signed. Quick follow-up from our finance ops side: BrightApps elected the 3-year prepay at a 20% term discount (SOW attached). For internal bookkeeping we need to confirm how you'd like us to present the invoices and what your revenue-recognition stakeholders expect.

Two options our customers commonly choose (we can accommodate either):
- Option A (annual split invoicing): We issue three invoices at the start of each contract year for the portion attributable to that fiscal year (e.g., Year 1 = 60% of total, Year 2 = 25%, Year 3 = 15% based on agreed ramp). Redwood applies payment credit at receipt; revenue is recognized over the service period per Redwood’s revrec policy.
- Option B (single prepay with year-by-year ledger allocation): We invoice the full prepay up front, apply payment to the account, and Redwood posts internal ledger allocations across fiscal years for ASC 606 purposes; you receive a single payment transaction but will get an accounting schedule for your records.

Can you confirm which you prefer? Marcus, looping you for pricing/contract context. Amy, attaching the invoice schedule draft and the signed SOW so your accounting can review. If BrightApps prefers Option B, Rafael/Marissa from RevRec can provide the accounting breakdown we’ll attach to your payment confirmation.

Next steps: please reply with preference and whether your tax/legal team needs any specific invoice language.

Thanks,
Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0184

Attachments: signed_SOW.pdf, invoice_schedule_v1.xlsx

1) Can Redwood provide an Excel-friendly schedule that maps the prepay to fiscal-year recognized revenue (we run year-end close on Dec 31)?
2) Can invoices include the PO number and a breakdown line-item referencing the SOW ID?

We can accept one remittance for the full amount once those materials are provided. If you can share the schedule by EOD Tuesday (10/6) that would be ideal.

Amy / Olga — attaching the revrec lookup we discussed (revrec_lookup_sheet.csv) and a more detailed invoice schedule (invoice_schedule_v1.xlsx). Summary of the proposed treatment: 

- Billing: Redwood will issue a single invoice for the full prepay amount on 2026-10-08 with PO and SOW ID on the invoice (matches your preference). Payment will be applied to your account when received.
- Ledger & RevRec: Redwood will internally allocate the prepay across fiscal years per the ramp percentages (60% / 25% / 15%). Revenue will be recognized ratably over each 12-month service period per ASC 606 principles; our schedule shows the portion recognized in each fiscal year and ties to the invoice line items.
- Audit package: we will include the Excel schedule and a one-page explanatory memo for your auditors.

If BrightApps needs us to split the invoice transactionally (i.e., three separate taxable invoices per year) we can do that, but it requires additional accounting entries and we typically only do that when customers have tax or cashflow constraints. Let me know if you want the transactional split instead of internal allocation.

Attachments: revrec_lookup_sheet.csv, invoice_schedule_v1.xlsx

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
